findings.title: Reflected XSS via unescaped request.referer in inline script
findings.body: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` line 11, `request.referer` is interpolated into a single-quoted JavaScript string literal (`'<%= request.referer %>'`). Standard ERB HTML-escaping (`<%= %>`) only escapes HTML characters (`<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, and `'`); if `'` is not escaped or if a referer URL contains a backslash or other JS-significant sequence on an allowed `embeddable_host` (e.g., via the path or query string), it can break out of the JS string literal and execute arbitrary script in the Discourse origin context. `to_json` (or extracting the origin on the server) should be used when embedding values into JavaScript.

findings.title: Invalid Ruby syntax `<%- end if %>` causes SyntaxError when rendering best.html.erb
findings.body: Line 6 of `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` closes the `if` block with `<%- end if %>`. In Ruby/ERB, `end if` is not valid syntax for closing an `if` statement (it parses as `end` followed by a trailing `if` modifier with no condition and no `end`), which will raise a `SyntaxError` whenever `EmbedController#best` renders the `best` template.

findings.title: Unsanitized RSS/Atom feed HTML is stored and rendered raw, enabling stored XSS
findings.body: `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` unescapes the feed item content (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) and passes it directly to `TopicEmbed.import`, which creates a post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. Because `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly without running `PrettyText` or any HTML sanitizer when `cook_method` is `raw_html`, any `<script>` tags or event handlers present in the RSS feed (or if the feed is compromised or contains user-supplied content) will be stored in `cooked` and executed in the browser of every user viewing the topic or embedded frame.

findings.title: NoMethodError when RSS feed items use `description` instead of `content`
findings.body: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` line 35, `i.content.scrub` assumes `i.content` is always a non-nil `String`. In RSS 2.0 feeds parsed by `SimpleRSS`, items typically populate `description` (or `content_encoded`) rather than `content`, leaving `i.content` as `nil`. Calling `.scrub` on `nil` raises `NoMethodError` and aborts polling for the entire feed.

findings.title: Loop overwrites `post` variable, causing imported Disqus replies to fail or attach to wrong topic
findings.body: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` line 148, `post` holds the initial topic post created by `TopicEmbed.import_remote`. Inside `t[:posts].each` on line 174, `post = PostCreator.new(post_user, attrs).create` overwrites that outer `post` variable. If `PostCreator#create` returns `nil` or an unsaved post (e.g., due to validation failure), line 175 (`post.post_number`), subsequent iterations' `post.topic_id` (line 161), and line 177 (`post.topic`) will either raise `NoMethodError` on `nil` or reference a failed post with no `topic_id`.
